Exercise D – Choose the Correct Answer (1 mark each)
Choose the correct answer.
  • 31. Our next door neighbour ………… his car every Sunday.
    ✓ B – washes (habitual action → simple present)
  • 32. Last summer, I ………… to the beach almost every day.
    ✓ A – went (past simple with "last summer")
  • 33. 'Whose is this plane ticket on the floor?' 'Oh, it ………… to me. Thank you.'
    ✓ B – belongs (stative verb, no continuous)
  • 34. 'I'm really tired of travelling so much.' 'I thought you ………… a bit quiet.'
    ✓ D – seemed (stative verb in past simple)
  • 35. 'You look thoughtful.' 'I ………… about our holiday last year.'
    ✓ D – was just thinking (past continuous for interrupted action)
  • 36. 'You went to Chile, didn't you?' 'No, but I ………… to Peru, which is right next door.'
    ✓ C – did go (emphatic past simple)

Choose the correct answer.
